C08-M09-L04-F1.title: Route a user report by interaction
C08-M09-L04-F1.caption: What the reporter did guides the first protective handoff and the checks that follow.
C08-M09-L04-F1.alt: Five rows connect message only, link followed, secret entry or prompt approval, file opened, and money moved or payment instructions changed with mail, telemetry, identity, endpoint and finance actions respectively.
C08-M09-L04-F1.note: An urgent handoff can proceed while the mail investigation continues.
